mapper.sql:
WITH current_data AS ( SELECT b.material_code, MAX(c.teli_code) AS teli_code, MAX(b.material_desc) AS material_desc, MAX(a.product_model) AS product_model, a.online_plan, SUM(a.unit_count) AS qty_current FROM marketing_aerial_boom_dplan a LEFT JOIN marketing_aerial_boom_bom b ON a.precise_bom = b.precise_bom LEFT JOIN buyer_code_config c ON b.material_code = c.host_code WHERE a.online_plan IS NOT NULL AND a.import_time = TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND a.plate = #{plate}
GROUP BY b.material_code, a.online_plan ), compare_data AS ( SELECT b.material_code, a.online_plan, SUM(a.unit_count) AS qty_compare FROM marketing_aerial_boom_dplan a LEFT JOIN marketing_aerial_boom_bom b ON a.precise_bom = b.precise_bom WHERE a.online_plan IS NOT NULL AND a.import_time = TO_DATE(#{compareDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND a.plate = #{plate}
GROUP BY b.material_code, a.online_plan ), all_materials AS ( SELECT material_code FROM current_data UNION SELECT material_code FROM compare_data ), material_info AS ( SELECT m.material_code, (SELECT MAX(c.teli_code) FROM buyer_code_config c WHERE c.host_code = m.material_code) AS teli_code, (SELECT MAX(b.material_desc) FROM marketing_aerial_boom_bom b WHERE b.material_code = m.material_code) AS material_desc, (SELECT MAX(b.product_model) FROM marketing_aerial_boom_bom b WHERE b.material_code = m.material_code) AS product_model FROM all_materials m ), all_dates AS ( SELECT online_plan FROM current_data UNION SELECT online_plan FROM compare_data ), ordered_dates AS ( SELECT online_plan, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY online_plan) AS rn FROM all_dates ) SELECT mi.material_code, mi.teli_code, mi.material_desc, mi.product_model, od.online_plan, COALESCE(cd.qty_current, 0) AS current_qty, COALESCE(cmp.qty_compare, 0) AS compare_qty, COALESCE(cd.qty_current, 0) - COALESCE(cmp.qty_compare, 0) AS diff_qty FROM material_info mi CROSS JOIN ordered_dates od LEFT JOIN current_data cd ON cd.material_code = mi.material_code AND cd.online_plan = od.online_plan LEFT JOIN compare_data cmp ON cmp.material_code = mi.material_code AND cmp.online_plan = od.online_plan
AND mi.material_code LIKE '%' || #{materialCode} || '%'
AND mi.product_model LIKE '%' || #{productModel} || '%'
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROWNUM AS rn FROM (
ORDER BY mi.material_code, od.rn ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize}) ) t2 WHERE t2.rn > ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize})
mapper.sql:
WITH current_data AS ( SELECT b.material_code, MAX(c.teli_code) AS teli_code, MAX(b.material_desc) AS material_desc, MAX(a.product_model) AS product_model, TO_CHAR(a.online_plan, 'YYYY-IW') AS week_key, MIN(a.online_plan) AS week_start, MAX(a.online_plan) AS week_end, SUM(a.unit_count) AS qty_current FROM marketing_aerial_boom_dplan a LEFT JOIN marketing_aerial_boom_bom b ON a.precise_bom = b.precise_bom LEFT JOIN buyer_code_config c ON b.material_code = c.host_code WHERE a.online_plan IS NOT NULL AND a.import_time = TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND a.plate = #{plate}
GROUP BY b.material_code, TO_CHAR(a.online_plan, 'YYYY-IW') ), compare_data AS ( SELECT b.material_code, TO_CHAR(a.online_plan, 'YYYY-IW') AS week_key, SUM(a.unit_count) AS qty_compare FROM marketing_aerial_boom_dplan a LEFT JOIN marketing_aerial_boom_bom b ON a.precise_bom = b.precise_bom WHERE a.online_plan IS NOT NULL AND a.import_time = TO_DATE(#{compareDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND a.plate = #{plate}
GROUP BY b.material_code, TO_CHAR(a.online_plan, 'YYYY-IW') ), all_materials AS ( SELECT material_code FROM current_data UNION SELECT material_code FROM compare_data ), material_info AS ( SELECT m.material_code, (SELECT MAX(c.teli_code) FROM buyer_code_config c WHERE c.host_code = m.material_code) AS teli_code, (SELECT MAX(b.material_desc) FROM marketing_aerial_boom_bom b WHERE b.material_code = m.material_code) AS material_desc, (SELECT MAX(b.product_model) FROM marketing_aerial_boom_bom b WHERE b.material_code = m.material_code) AS product_model FROM all_materials m ), all_weeks AS ( SELECT week_key, MIN(week_start) AS week_start, MAX(week_end) AS week_end FROM (SELECT week_key, week_start, week_end FROM current_data UNION SELECT week_key, NULL, NULL FROM compare_data) GROUP BY week_key ), ordered_weeks AS ( SELECT week_key, week_start, week_end, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MIN(week_start)) AS rn FROM all_weeks GROUP BY week_key, week_start, week_end ) SELECT mi.material_code, mi.teli_code, mi.material_desc, mi.product_model, ow.week_key AS weekKey, TO_CHAR(ow.week_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS weekStartDate, TO_CHAR(ow.week_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS weekEndDate, COALESCE(cd.qty_current, 0) AS currentQty, COALESCE(cmp.qty_compare, 0) AS compareQty, COALESCE(cd.qty_current, 0) - COALESCE(cmp.qty_compare, 0) AS diffQty FROM material_info mi CROSS JOIN ordered_weeks ow LEFT JOIN current_data cd ON cd.material_code = mi.material_code AND cd.week_key = ow.week_key LEFT JOIN compare_data cmp ON cmp.material_code = mi.material_code AND cmp.week_key = ow.week_key
AND mi.material_code LIKE '%' || #{materialCode} || '%'
AND mi.product_model LIKE '%' || #{productModel} || '%'
ORDER BY mi.material_code, ow.rn
